request: Order ORD-1001 hasn't shipped yet. Investigate why and what we should do.

steps.text: I will first look up the order details to see its fulfillment status, promised delivery date, fulfillment warehouse, and line items.
I will check on-hand and available stock for each ordered SKU at the order’s warehouse to see if there’s a shortage preventing fulfillment.
I will search other warehouses for 38 units of SKU-202 to see if a single site can cover the shortfall for a stock transfer.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1001 has not shipped because the fulfillment warehouse (WH-BOS) does not have enough stock of SKU-202 (only 12 available vs 50 ordered). Chicago (WH-CHI) has sufficient inventory to cover the 38-unit shortfall.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1001 at WH-BOS, fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-19, items: SKU-202 quantity 50, days_until_promised_date 3 (is_past_promised_date false)
check_inventory: SKU-202 at WH-BOS on_hand 12, reserved 0, available 12 (ordered 50)
find_alternative_stock: required_quantity 38, WH-CHI available 80 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 30 cannot cover; WH-DAL available 0 cannot cover
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient available inventory of SKU-202 at the assigned warehouse (WH-BOS) to fulfill the ordered quantity.
uncertainties: Transfer transit time from WH-CHI to WH-BOS and processing time at WH-BOS are unknown, so ability to meet the 2026-03-19 promised date is uncertain.
arguments.recommendation: Initiate an urgent inter-warehouse transfer of 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI to WH-BOS and schedule pick/pack upon receipt to fulfill ORD-1001.
